title: Onboard Latent-7B v1.0: metadata, performance profiles, and changelog automation
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Add Latent-7B v1.0 model metadata, performance profiles, and automated changelog generation for registry UI and release notes.
description:
Context: Add Latent-7B v1.0 to the model registry with full metadata (arch, tokenizer, recommended quantization profiles), curated performance profiles for common serving configurations, and automation that appends a concise changelog entry to the registry release notes on merge. Motivation: Latent-7B is a high-quality 7B open model that we want available in hosted and private modes with validated perf characteristics so customers get predictable latency/cost signals. This PR bundles three related changes to avoid drift between model metadata and release notes automation.

What changed (single continuous description):
- Added model metadata JSON (specifies architecture, tokenizer, input limits, license, recommended kv-cache behavior).
- Added perf profiles generated from perf-lab runs across target instance types (A100-80GB, A10G, T4) including median latency, p95/p99, and tokens/sec for 128/512/1024 context lengths. Profiles include recommended default config (batch size, quantization, kv-cache).
- Hooked model registry changelog automation: a minimal templated entry is generated and appended to registry-changelog.md when a PR labeled "automation" and merged to main. The template includes model name, version, short description, and link to perf profiles.
- Documentation: registry docs updated with onboarding checklist and instructions for re-running perf profile generation locally.

Checklist:
- [x] Metadata file added and validated against schema
- [x] Perf profiles generated and validated by perf-lab CI
- [x] Changelog automation tested in staging (dry-run)
- [x] Docs updated and internal HOWTO included
- [x] Tests: unit and schema validations added

Notes on perf generation: Perf runs were executed using perf-canary harness on A100-80GB and A10G. Each measurement is median of 5 runs; p95/p99 computed across microbenchmarks. The perf profiles are conservative (favor latency SLOs) and include an alternative config optimized for throughput.

Migration and rollout: Adding this model does not change existing models. No runtime code changes required; customers can opt in by selecting "latent-7b:v1.0" in the model picker. Changelog automation will create a human-readable entry which the docs team reviews during release cut.

CI: initial run failed lint for registry-changelog formatting; fixed by adjusting templating whitespace and re-run. Performance CI flagged a minor non-determinism on T4; reran and averaged metrics. All checks passed on the final run.

Merge: squash merge into main after approvals.

perf_summary: Latent-7B v1.0 perf summary: A100-80GB (single GPU): median 25 tokens/sec at 512 context, p95=120ms, p99=180ms. A10G: median 15 tokens/sec, p95=200ms. T4: median 6 tokens/sec, higher variance; recommended for cost-sensitive throughput but not low-latency SLOs. Throughput profile (4x A100) achieves ~85 tokens/sec with batching and kv-cache enabled.
notes: Docs team notified of changelog automation; a short review will be done during the next release cut. If any regressions are observed in perf metrics, revert by tagging the model as deprecated in the registry and open ENG-2145 for follow-up.
